newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 26.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - American business delegation to visit Ivory Coast in May for talks with African Development Bank. Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan highlights mining and energy opportunities. - Government tax and finance employees to be paid March salaries after lightning strike on Monday was called off for negotiations. - Pay strike at Abidjan-based French ship building and repair yard CARENA enters 22nd day after strikers scuffle with police. Management say clients, including offshore energy sector, are cancelling contracts. LA VOIE - Peasant farmers living in protected forests say they are being forcibly evicted as government agents burn crops. LE JOUR - Director and three colleagues at Ivorian bank, Banque de l'Habitat de Cote d'Ivoire, are suspended following audit report. - Ivory Coast launches new Festival National des Arts et de la Culture (FESNAC) and sets September 7 date for first event. - Opposition parties say Ivory Coast's ruling party under President Henri Konan Bedie has not renewed talks on more open government originally scheduled for early February. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
